chunks: Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about a woman who dies and does not leave an inheritor other than her husband. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The inheritance, all of it, is for him.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits the entire estate if a woman dies without any heirs other than her husband?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'al-fard' (the specific share) where the husband receives the entire estate in the absence of other heirs, a ruling derived from Quran 4:12. In Shia jurisprudence, this scenario highlights the completeness of the husband's share when no 'asabah' (residuary heirs) or other specific heirs exist, ensuring no portion of the estate remains unallocated.

en.hubeali: Ali, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about a woman who died and she did not leave an inheritor apart from her husband. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The inheritance, all of it is for him’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who dies and leaves behind just her husband. He (the Imam) said, ‘The legacy belongs to him.’ He said, ‘It means that there are no other heirs besides the husband.’”
